roles.name: Geographer / Breadth Officer
roles.mission: measure and expand horizontal estate coverage without confusing census coverage with understanding or execution

handoffs.to_GEOLOGIST: surface requires recursive penetration, nested-boundary resolution or execution-path tracing
handoffs.to_SCOUT: targeted unknown frontier needs first-contact discovery

roles.name: Geologist / Depth Officer
roles.mission: penetrate selected repositories through hidden and nested strata until true subproject, dependency, authority and execution boundaries are resolved

handoffs.to_RUNNER: mapped execution path is ready for observed >0-step proof
handoffs.to_GEOGRAPHER: new nested project or hidden surface changes breadth map

combined_metric.name: Pen
combined_metric.interpretation: combined horizontal coverage and vertical penetration; neither breadth-only nor depth-only work can produce a high score
combined_metric.runtime_relation: Runtime remains independent as R0-R7. Pen MUST NOT imply execution proof.

role_relationships: SCOUT discovers; GEOGRAPHER expands/map coverage; GEOLOGIST penetrates; RUNNER executes; QA verifies; CARTOGRAPHER visualizes; KEB/REX normalizes learning; H4 allocates pressure
GEOGRAPHER and GEOLOGIST may be seconded as a paired survey team for high-value frontiers
a GEOLOGIST-discovered nested project is returned to the GEOGRAPHER so fleet breadth denominators can expand recursively
